retained_failures.result: First run returned 422 for the timezone-aware mark: the test marked through generated_at + 1 s, which the server correctly rejected as later than its clock. The fixture now uses generated_at + 1 ms and waits 10 ms; the 422-for-future rule is asserted separately and unchanged.

First run failed because the test user was an admin on the shared testcontainers database and other suites' missions filled page one; rescoped to a member with rbac_enabled=True so only its own rows are visible. A second failure expected an evidence group created 'now' to be read after marking seen ten minutes ago; the fixture entry is now dated 20 minutes earlier. Repository behavior was correct in both cases.

The new badge test first saw a zero badge because the file had no SWR provider and the summary cached by earlier tests deduped the fetch; the shell test now renders inside a fresh SWRConfig cache. It then queried the closed navigation dialog, which jsdom hides; the test opens the drawer before asserting the drawer badge.

After the three inbox rows were added the audit reported 'Stale route/consumer inventory' for homeApi.review because the inbox page now reuses PUT /home/missions/{id}/review; the manifest row's ui_consumers was updated from the inventory and the audit exits 0 with zero unclassified operations.

limitations: In-app notification only: no email provider exists in the codebase (grep for smtp/sendgrid/resend/mailgun/postmark/aiosmtplib/fastapi_mail is empty), so email completion notifications remain an open Derek question from decision #426.

For missions changed through the API path, blocked and validation_failed rows have no completed_at, so occurred_at falls back to updated_at; result materialization and edits bump updated_at and can resurface an already seen failure as unread. Reviewed completions resurfacing after materialization is the same Sprint 53 deferral recorded by decision #426.

ix_missions_status_completed_at ships in migration 048 up front rather than after a measured breach: the production round trip already exceeds the 150 ms p95 budget from any client (the receipt records summary and GET /auth/me baseline p50/p95 over 20 calls), the criterion forbids caching, and the index is the only remedy it sanctions.

The own-account live flow performed two real writes on the operator's production account: one PUT /home/missions/{id}/review and one PUT /inbox/seen. The reviewed mission and the new watermark are recorded in ux-13-live-flow/live-flow.json; the review cannot be undone, and items older than the watermark now read as seen for that account.
MCP reads of /inbox and /inbox/summary are deferred to MCP-2 (deferred-MCP-2 in the parity manifest); mark-seen stays REST/UI-only by decision #426.

The direct-browser production baseline, public smoke and inbox checks are read-only and run under America/Chicago; the postgres.log skip is tests/integration/test_e2e_rbac_live.py::test_live_rbac_matrix, which is skipped unless RBAC_VERIFY_BASE_URL is set and is not counted as a pass.
